mapper.select: SELECT id, investigation_id, run_id, source, artifact_ref, location, supports_hypothesis_ids, contradicts_hypothesis_ids, summary, payload_json, created_at FROM observation WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO observation (investigation_id, run_id, source, artifact_ref, location, supports_hypothesis_ids, contradicts_hypothesis_ids, summary, payload_json) VALUES (#{investigationId}, #{runId}, #{source}, #{artifactRef}, #{location}, #{supportsHypothesisIds}, #{contradictsHypothesisIds}, #{summary}, #{payloadJson})
